description: Block git commits if quality gates fail

hooks.command: INPUT=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '^git\s+commit'; then echo 'Running quality gates before commit...' && npm test --silent 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Tests failed. Fix tests before committing.' && exit 1; fi; fi; exit 0

usage: Optionnel. Bloque git commit si les tests échouent. Adaptez 'npm test' à votre commande de test (cargo test, pnpm test, etc.).
